description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מגדירה מי נחשב 'עובד' במסגרת פוליסת ביטוח אחריות מקצועית ליועצי השקעות. ההגדרה כוללת עובדים נוכחיים ובעבר, שותפים, דירקטורים, יועצים, סטודנטים ועוד. ניתן לעיין בטבלה כדי להבין אילו קטגוריות של אנשים מכוסים על ידי הפוליסה. ההגדרה כוללת עובדים, שותפים, דירקטורים, יועצים, עובדים זמניים, חברי ועדות השקעה, עובדים לשעבר, שותפים לשעבר, יועצים לשעבר, סטודנטים ועוזרים.

(a) All  those  persons  employed  by  the  Assured  and/or  under  a  contract  of  service  with  the Assured,  including  Partners  and  Executive  or  non-executive  Directors,  Consultants  and temporary  Employees  employed  by  the  Assured  or  employment  agencies  of  any  class whatsoever  or  the  individual  members  of  Investment  Committees  while  acting  their capacity  as  the  independent  review  committee  of  the  Assured's  Provident  and  Mutual Funds.

(c)   All associates and former associates.
(d)   All guest students pursuing studies or duties at the Assured's premises.

payload:
טבלה: הגדרת עובדים
This table defines who is considered an 'Employee' under the insurance policy for professional liability of investment advisors. It outlines different categories of individuals included in the definition.
ממדים: Employee Category, Definition Details

"Employees" shall mean:
(a) All  those  persons  employed  by  the  Assured  and/or  under  a  contract  of  service  with  the Assured,  including  Partners  and  Executive  or  non-executive  Directors,  Consultants  and temporary  Employees  employed  by  the  Assured  or  employment  agencies  of  any  class whatsoever  or  the  individual  members  of  Investment  Committees  while  acting  their capacity  as  the  independent  review  committee  of  the  Assured's  Provident  and  Mutual Funds.
(b) All  former  employees,  former  partners,  former  executives  or  non-executive  directors, former  consultants  and  former  temporary  employees  employed  by  the  Assured  or employment agencies.
(c)   All associates and former associates.
(d)   All guest students pursuing studies or duties at the Assured's premises.
